# Rolling Stone Album Analysis

Author: Brandon Linck-Hernandez

## About this project

This project explores changes in release-decade and recorded genre
representation across Rolling Stone's 2003, 2012 and 2020 album lists.

The analysis uses R and tidyverse packages, follows the CRISP-DM
framework, and presents the findings in a Quarto HTML report.

## Project files

- `Final_DSC8001_Project.qmd` — report text and analysis code.
- `rolling_stone.csv` — original dataset.
- `Final_DSC8001_Project.html` — rendered report.
- `README.md` — project setup and reproduction instructions.
